再回北荒（再回北荒（第22页）李寒山没有惊动那些弟子。他的化神级神识如同一张无形的大网，无声无息地覆盖了整座分宗。主峰大殿中坐着一个他熟悉的身影——苏元，当初和柳缨一起来接管分宗的那个男修。元婴后期的修为，比几年前又精进了几分，正靠在主位上闭目养神，手边放着一卷打开的玉简。而在主峰南侧一处偏僻的院落中，李寒山感知到了另一道熟悉的气息。二长老。她依旧穿着那身红衣，但衣袍的颜色比从前黯淡了许多。她的修为仍是元婴中期，但被关在院子里，身上带伤，院子外还有着足以困住她的禁制。院门外站着两个金丹男修，显然是看守。李寒山的目光收回，落在了主峰大殿中的苏元身上。他的指尖微微收紧，却没有立刻动手。他等到了入夜。夜色如墨，主峰大殿中的烛火早已熄灭。苏元正在内室打坐，忽然感觉到一股令他头皮发麻的压迫感从四面八方涌来。他猛地睁开眼，却看到一道青色的身影正站在他面前，面容年轻，目光平静，周身的气息却如同深不可测的寒潭。“你……“苏元的话还没说完，便认出了那张脸。虽然比几年前年轻了许多，但那双眼睛他绝不会认错——李寒山。那个当初跟着夜霜华去了中洲的北荒老头。“李寒山？！你不是去中洲了——““去了，又回来了。“李寒山的声音平静，“二长老在哪儿？“苏元的脸色瞬间变得惨白。他想要催动灵力，却发现自己的丹田如同被铁箍套住了一般，灵力运转凝滞如冻。那股压迫感太过厚重了，压得他连手指都抬不起来。而李寒山只是站在那里看着他，如同在看一只伸腿可及的蚂蚁。“你……你是什么修为？“苏元的声音都在发抖。苏元完全没想到，这才几年没见，李寒山的修为居然变得如此恐怖了！天！他是怎么修炼的，这还是人吗？李寒山没有回答。他抬手，一道紫金色的灵力从掌心涌出，精准地没入苏元的丹田。苏元闷哼一声，身体猛地一僵，元婴表面的灵力流转被彻底封死。他挣扎了两下，便如同一截被抽去筋骨的木头，瘫软在地上，眼中满是恐惧。“二长老的伤，是你做的？““不、不是。“苏元连忙摇头，额头上冷汗淋漓，“我只是让她考虑考虑噗“苏元话还没说话，就被李寒山击中，吐出一大口血来。这一击，要了他大半条命。李寒山没有再多问。他转身走出大殿，夜色中那道紫金色的遁光如同无声的闪电，掠过主峰南侧那处偏僻的院落。两个看守的修士甚至来不及反应，便被两道精准的灵力击中丹田，软软倒地。院门推开，二长老正靠在石壁上闭目调息，听到动静猛地睁开眼。她的目光落在门口那道身影上时，那双美眸先是茫然了一瞬，随即猛地睁大。她张了张嘴，似乎想说什么，却被李寒山抢先了一步：“我来接你。“二长老盯着他看了好一会儿，然后别过头去，用袖子飞快地擦了一下眼角，声音沙哑却带着几分倔强：“你这老头，怎么才来。“她站起身，红衣在夜风中微微飘动，虽然狼狈，却依旧带着那股子不肯低头的劲儿。李寒山伸手扶住她的胳膊，纯阳之气沿着掌心渡入她的经脉。二长老的身体微微一颤，感觉到一股温润到极点的气息进入她的身体，滋润着她的丹田。灵力恢复的畅快感让她忍不住微微吸了一口气。“你伤得不轻。“李寒山感知着她丹田中的状况，“先跟我走。路上慢慢恢复。“

Returning to Beihuang (Returning to Beihuang (page 22)) Li Hanshan did not disturb those disciples. His god-level consciousness was like a large invisible net, covering the entire branch sect silently. Sitting in the main hall of the main peak was a man he knew well. The familiar figure - Su Yuan, the male cultivator who came to take over the branch sect with Liu Ying. Yuan Ying's later cultivation has improved a lot compared to a few years ago. He is leaning on the main seat with his eyes closed and concentrating, with an open jade slip in his hand. In a remote courtyard on the south side of the main peak, Li Hanshan sensed another familiar scent. She was still wearing the same red robe, but the color of her robe was much darker than before. In the middle period, she was locked up in the courtyard with injuries, and there were restrictions outside the courtyard that were enough to trap her. There were two male Jindan cultivators standing outside the courtyard, who were obviously guards. Li Hanshan's eyes returned and fell on Su Yuan in the main hall. His fingertips tightened slightly, but he didn't move immediately. He waited until nightfall, and the candles in the main hall were already extinguished. Su Yuan was meditating in the inner room, and suddenly he felt a numbing pressure coming from all directions. He opened his eyes suddenly, and saw a green figure standing in front of him, with a young face and calm eyes, but the aura around him was like an unfathomable cold pool. Before he finished speaking, he recognized that face. Although he was much younger than he had been a few years ago, he could never mistake those eyes - Li Hanshan, the old man from Beihuang who had followed Ye Shuanghua to Central Continent. "Li Hanshan?! You've gone to Central Continent -" Li Hanshan's voice was calm, "Where is the second elder?" Su Yuan's face turned pale in an instant. He wanted to activate his spiritual power, but found that his Dantian was blocked. It was as if the iron hoop was holding him, and his spiritual power was stagnant. The pressure was so heavy that he couldn't even lift his fingers. But Li Hanshan just stood there and looked at him, as if he was looking at an ant within reach. Su Yuan's voice was trembling. He didn't expect that Li Hanshan's cultivation had become so terrifying in just a few years! Oh my god! How did he cultivate? Li Hanshan didn't answer. He raised his hand, and a stream of purple-gold spiritual power surged out from his palm and penetrated Su Yuan's Dantian accurately. Su Yuan groaned, and his body stiffened suddenly, and the flow of spiritual power on the surface of Yuan Ying was completely blocked. After two pricks, it was like a piece of wood that had been stripped of its muscles and bones, and lay limp on the ground, with fear in his eyes. "Did you do the second elder's injury?" "No, no." Su Yuan shook his head quickly, with cold sweat dripping from his forehead, "I." Just let her think about it. "Before Su Yuan could say anything, he was hit by Li Hanshan and spit out a large mouthful of blood. This blow cost him most of his life. Li Hanshan didn't ask any more questions. He turned around and walked out of the hall, and that road in the night The purple-gold escaping light was like silent lightning, passing over the remote courtyard on the south side of the main peak. The two guarding monks didn't even have time to react before they were hit by two precise spiritual powers and fell to the ground softly. Lao Zheng was leaning against the stone wall with her eyes closed and her eyes suddenly opened when she heard the movement. When her eyes fell on the figure at the door, her beautiful eyes were blank for a moment, and then she opened her mouth suddenly, as if she wanted to say something. But Li Hanshan beat him to it: "I'll pick you up." The second elder stared at him for a while, then turned away, quickly wiped the corners of his eyes with his sleeve, and said in a hoarse but somewhat stubborn voice: "You old man,Why did you come? "She stood up, her red clothes fluttering slightly in the night wind. Although she was embarrassed, she still had the energy that refused to bow her head. Li Hanshan stretched out his hand to support her arm, and the pure Yang energy flowed into her meridians along the palm of his hand. The second elder's body trembled slightly, and she felt an extremely warm breath entering her body, nourishing her Dantian. The pleasure of recovering her spiritual power made her take a slight breath. "You are seriously injured. Li Hanshan sensed the situation in her Dantian and said, "Follow me first." Slow recovery on the road. "
